args.name: Cosy Coffee on a Rainy Windowsill — Vertical

style.prompt: A cosy illustrated animation composed for a vertical 9:16 frame. A ceramic coffee cup rests on a wooden windowsill beside a rain-streaked window. Delicate wisps of steam continuously curl gently upward from the hot coffee, clearly visible against the cool blue-grey window. Raindrops slowly slide down the glass, with softly blurred rainy scenery outside. Warm amber indoor light, muted earthy colours, soft hand-painted textures, charming storybook illustration, intimate peaceful atmosphere. Cup in the lower middle of the portrait composition with generous space above for the curling steam. Locked-off steady camera, subtle natural motion only, one continuous six-second shot, consistent cup shape and scene throughout. No text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Silent, no sound or music.
